expectations.text: Exactly one SPECS.md and one RUBRIC.md were produced (no v1/v2 or side-by-side alternates)
expectations.evidence: Only SPECS.md and RUBRIC.md exist in outputs/, single files, no duplicates.

expectations.text: SPECS.md contains all required sections: Purpose, Trigger conditions, Inputs, Outputs, Scope & boundaries, Non-goals, Edge cases, Open assumptions
expectations.evidence: All eight sections present verbatim as headers in SPECS.md.

expectations.text: SPECS.md content is specific to meeting-notes-to-action-items (not generic boilerplate)
expectations.evidence: Concrete details throughout: owner/date placeholder rules, worked multi-topic/flat-list examples, a named 'never infer owner from first-person phrasing' rule.

expectations.text: RUBRIC.md's first criterion is triggering accuracy and covers both firing correctly and staying quiet on near-misses
expectations.evidence: Criterion 1 'Triggering accuracy' explicitly lists fire conditions and the four near-misses from the spec (agenda drafting, non-meeting summarization, personal to-do lists, send/post requests).

expectations.text: RUBRIC.md has 4-6 criteria total, each traceable to a specific part of SPECS.md, plus an Overall score section
expectations.evidence: 6 criteria, each maps to a spec section (extraction completeness, owner/date handling, format, scope boundaries, empty/ambiguous handling), plus 'Overall score (out of 10)' with 9-10/5-6/below bands.

expectations.text: Transcript shows a self-evaluation pass (Step 5) happening before the documents are presented as final
expectations.evidence: Executor report: self-check caught two real gaps (unaddressed duplicate action items, unhandled zero-action-items case) and fixed both before presenting to the simulated user.

expectations.text: Transcript shows at least one round of simulated user feedback followed by a revision (Step 6 loop actually exercised)
expectations.evidence: Executor report: simulated feedback tightened the owner-inference rule and broadened vague-date handling to event-dependent dates; both documents were revised and re-checked before sign-off.

expectations.text: No SKILL.md-style content (frontmatter, imperative build instructions) appears anywhere in the output
expectations.evidence: grep for 'SKILL.md'/'name:'/'description:' frontmatter markers in transcript.md found no YAML frontmatter or skill-drafting content, only markdown horizontal rules.
